Maya Patel: quick sync — an SI partner asked for a clear, repeatable pattern for transfer of co-sell leads. They want ownership guarantees, SLA expectations, and visibility into where a lead sits. can we align on a simple playbook?

Jordan Lee: +1. propose tiered claim windows by expected ARR. e.g. Tier A (>= $500k) immediate claim, Tier B 48h, Tier C 7 days. keeps high-value stuff moving.

Sam Ortiz: agree. also need account mapping rules (parent/child dedupe, regional ownership). rough CSV sketch: 
```
tier,threshold_usd,claim_window_hours,default_owner
A,500000,4,field_rep
B,100000,48,partner
C,0,168,partner_ops_queue
```

Liam Chen: add overlap resolution: if field claims inside window -> field owns; if both claim simultaneously -> escalate to PartnerOps triage. also need to capture "already-owned" tags from CRM to avoid reclaims.

Anya R.: can we make the handoff visibility-first? auto-notify both parties with lead summary + recommended next step template so nothing falls to email. template example: 
"Intro + propose 30m call — propose dates Y/M/D".

PartnerOps Bot: New intake created: SI Lead #7721 for account "Westlake Labs" — https://partnerops/redwood/leads/7721

Maya Patel: action items from this thread: Jordan to draft claim SLA doc, Sam to formalize mapping CSV and upload, Liam to add an escalation flow (PagerDuty + Slack play). I'll set a 1-week checkpoint.

Jordan Lee: will draft SLA doc today and put a stub in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-1234

Sam Ortiz: uploading mapping CSV to Drive now — https://drive.google.com/example (shared with Partnerships & PartnerOps)

Liam Chen: quick q — do we bake this into Marketplace intake or keep PartnerOps as the source of truth? my vote: keep Marketplace as opt-in signal, PartnerOps handles the richer mapping and SLA enforcement.

Anya R.: agree. Marketplace should remain a light-weight discovery/opt-in. PartnerOps has to own final claim and resolution.

Maya Patel: perfect. small note: legal may want a simple clause for co-sell crediting if partner claims and does initial intro. i'll ping Legal for guidance.

Jordan Lee: noted. will add a "crediting note" section to the SLA doc.

PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: weekly SI sync in #partnerships tomorrow 9:00am PT.

Maya Patel: thanks team :thumbsup: we'll reconvene next Tuesday at the checkpoint.

Jordan Lee: +1

Sam Ortiz: thanks, everyone.

Liam Chen: thanks!
